items.sql: SELECT SUM(amount_cents) / 100.0 AS revenue_dollars FROM payments WHERE status = 'succeeded'

SELECT p.method AS payment_method, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN p.status = 'failed' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS failure_percentage FROM payments p WHERE p.status IN ('failed', 'succeeded') GROUP BY p.method ORDER BY failure_percentage DESC
SELECT SUM(amount_cents) / 100.0 AS revenue_dollars FROM payments WHERE status = 'succeeded'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS staff_count FROM employees

SELECT COUNT(*) AS expense_claims_waiting FROM expense_reports WHERE status = 'submitted' AND submitted_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - make_interval(days => 90) AND submitted_at <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00'

SELECT s.region, COUNT(*) AS deals_won, SUM(o.amount_cents) / 100.0 AS total_value_dollars FROM opportunities o JOIN sales_reps s ON o.rep_id = s.id WHERE o.closed_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - make_interval(days => 180) AND o.closed_at <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' AND o.stage = 'won' GROUP BY s.region
SELECT COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM employees WHERE terminated_at IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT org_id) AS churned_customers FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'canceled' AND canceled_at > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - INTERVAL '30 days' AND canceled_at <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00'

SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) AS count_events FROM subscription_events WHERE occurred_at > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - INTERVAL '90 days' AND occurred_at <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' GROUP BY event_type HAVING event_type IN ('upgraded', 'downgraded')

SELECT c.code, SUM(cr.redeemed_at IS NOT NULL) AS redemption_count FROM coupons c LEFT JOIN coupon_redemptions cr ON c.id = cr.coupon_id WHERE cr.redeemed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.code ORDER BY redemption_count DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT
  (COUNT(CASE WHEN i.status = 'open' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage_unpaid
FROM invoices i
WHERE i.issued_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - make_interval(days => 90) AND i.issued_at <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00'
SELECT AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (resolved_at - created_at)) / 3600.0) AS avg_hours_to_resolution, priority FROM support_tickets WHERE status IN ('resolved', 'closed') GROUP BY priority

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS active_users FROM login_events WHERE success AND occurred_at > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - INTERVAL '7 days' AND occurred_at <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00'
SELECT role, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM users GROUP BY role
SELECT COUNT(*) AS api_keys_revoked FROM api_keys WHERE revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND revoked_at >= '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - INTERVAL '30 days'
